lines.zh: 我摆尾，水就从鳃边过去。
lines.en: One tailbeat and water passes my gills.

lines.zh: 我和沙丁鱼是远亲，个子更大。
lines.en: I am cousin to the sardine, but larger.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底游，背是暗的。
lines.en: I swim low, my back dark against the bed.
A flick of scales and I turn.

lines.zh: 我成群的时候，水都在动。
lines.en: When we school, the water itself moves.

lines.zh: 我的嘴朝上，专吃漂着的。
lines.en: My mouth turns up for whatever drifts.
I thread between the stones.

lines.zh: 鲱形的身子，游得慢但稳。
lines.en: A herring-shaped body, slow but steady.

lines.zh: 水面上的光，在我背上一格一格。
lines.en: Light on the surface steps along my back.

lines.zh: 我这一族，化石留在北美。
lines.en: My kind left fossils in North America.

lines.zh: 我转过半圈，鳞片全亮了。
lines.en: I turn half around and every scale lights.

lines.zh: 我很多年没见到同类了。
lines.en: I have not seen my own kind in years.

lines.zh: 我贴着岸边游，那里有吃的。
lines.en: I keep to the bank, where there is food.

lines.zh: 我往上抬了一点，看看水面。
lines.en: I rise a little to look at the surface.
My tail is stronger than my body.

lines.zh: 我游过一片水草，草都在晃。
lines.en: I pass a patch of weed and it all sways.

lines.zh: 水底的泥一扬，我就看不见了。
lines.en: The bed mud rises and I lose sight.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，像一片暗色的叶。
lines.en: Still, I look like a dark leaf.

lines.zh: 我的鳞是银的，背脊发青。
lines.en: Silver scales, a blue-green back.

lines.zh: 水从嘴里过，我筛出吃的。
lines.en: Water passes my mouth and I sieve out food.
My kind lasted a very long time.

lines.zh: 鱼群在远处转了个方向。
lines.en: The school turns somewhere off.
I spread my fins and steady myself.
It is quiet here, only bubbles.
I cannot blink. I can only watch.

lines.zh: 我的骨头很细，藏在肉里。
lines.en: My bones are fine, buried in flesh.

lines.zh: 青鱼、鳀鱼，都是我的亲戚。
lines.en: Herring and anchovy are my kin.

lines.zh: 我摆了一下鳍，水纹散开。
lines.en: One fin beat and the ripples spread.
I watch you crouch through the water's surface.
You lower your head and I sink.

lines.zh: 我见过更大的东西，也不怕。
lines.en: I have seen bigger things and was not afraid.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一层水面。
lines.en: A layer of water lies between us.
Do not reach in; the water clouds.

lines.zh: 我这张嘴，只吃得下小的。
lines.en: My mouth only takes small things.
I am watching to see if you enter.

lines.zh: 你影子落进水里，我摆尾避开。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the water; I flick my tail aside.
I dart far away in one burst.
Blood flows into my gills.
I squeeze into a stone crevice and scrape my scales.
That made me swim crooked.
My fin is a little torn.
Another blow and I sink to the bed.

lines.zh: 水花四溅，我的鳞片可不好受。
lines.en: The water splashes — my scales don't like this.
Stop splashing — I'm only a small fish.
That is one mouthful for me.
Drop it and it will sink.
I wait for it to drift to me.
I do not snatch; I open my mouth.
The taste in the water is faint.
Too dry. I will not eat it.

lines.zh: 有碎屑沉下来，我张了嘴。
lines.en: Bits sink down, and I open my mouth.
It circles on the surface.
You touch the water and I scatter.
The ripple pushed me aside.

lines.zh: 我的鳞蹭到石头上，掉了一片。
lines.en: A scale scraped off on the stone.
I blunder into the school and it scatters.
Back off; the water is cloudy.
That made me roll and swim off.
My fin brushed your finger.
The current pushed us together.
Your boots churn up the river mud.
Again, and I drop to the bottom.
There are many of my kind in the school.

lines.zh: 这种事在水里做，没声音。
lines.en: Such things happen in water, without sound.
My scales are brighter than usual.
Near the weed would be suitable.
I am only a fish. I do not understand this.
The spawning ground is downstream.
You watch and I stay still.
The water is busy this season.
Do not stir the water.
I open my mouth and swallow one.
This is too big to hold.
I test it with my lips.
It sinks; I follow.
A mouthful of mud. I spit it out.
Something hangs on the weed.
I nudge it against a stone.
Not edible. I let go.
I look up to see who dropped it.
I circle twice before biting.

lines.zh: 影子落进浅水，我看见了。
lines.en: A shadow falls into the shallows, and I see it.
I see it now. Food.
I turn and face it.
One bite at this distance.
I fold my dorsal fin back.
The ripples tell me where it is.
I am speeding up.
It hides in a crack.
I wait for it to come out.
I follow, not near, not far.
It speeds up; so do I.
The school helps block it.
I keep it in my side view.
Each of its turns, I correct.
The stone shadows help me.
It tires and slows.
It retreats to the shallows. Perfect.
I bite and swallow.
My teeth are small, but hooked inward.
That one cannot get free.

lines.zh: 我的背鳍擦过你的胫骨。
lines.en: My dorsal fin grazes your shin.
It is bigger than me, and I still bite.
I bite once and release.
This much strength is a meal.
I sweep my tail and stir up a layer of mud.
I do not like fighting, only swallowing.

lines.zh: 水草丛里，我摆了一下尾。
lines.en: I flick my tail among the waterweeds.

lines.zh: 第一口水，从我鳃里过去。
lines.en: The first water passes through my gills.
I am tiny; my scales are clear.
The light on the bed comes in steps.

lines.zh: 周围有很多像我一样的。
lines.en: Many like me all around.
I join the school.
The water here is not fast.
I open my mouth, learning to feed.

lines.zh: 北美那边的水里，也有我们。
lines.en: Our kind were in North American waters too.
I choose a patch of weed.

lines.zh: 从今天起，我在这一层游。
lines.en: From today, I swim at this level.
The surface seems to open. I sink.

lines.zh: 我被抛出水面，摔在岸上。
lines.en: I am thrown from the water onto the bank.

lines.zh: 水里有东西，我却喘不上。
lines.en: There is water everywhere and I cannot breathe.
The water bursts and I tumble.

lines.zh: 有东西穿进水里，扎中我。
lines.en: Something pierces the water and hits me.

lines.zh: 水里有一阵发麻，我僵住。
lines.en: A numbness spreads through the water and I freeze.

lines.zh: 没有吃的，我的肚子贴着骨头。
lines.en: With nothing to eat, my belly is against my bones.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我全身一震。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and my whole body jolts.
